chapter_title: The Rise of Open-Weights Models and Local Deployment

flashcards.front: Does local deployment eliminate per-token costs?
flashcards.explanation: Local models run on your own hardware, removing cloud API fees.

flashcards.front: Why is quantization necessary for local LLMs?
flashcards.back: Reduces memory footprint to fit on consumer hardware.
flashcards.explanation: Quantization compresses model weights, allowing large models to run on limited VRAM.
